verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's own GitHub repository says it ships SDKs for 15+ languages (TypeScript, .NET, Java and more) with framework integrations such as React and Next.js. The docs refer to its server-side and client-side SDKs, and it also offers OpenFeature providers. Missing for 10: per-SDK reference documentation in the evidence (installation, API surface, language list beyond examples), and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
